title: No regression coverage is linked for OCR overlay request branching
reasoning: The route has three behavior branches: candidate_id lookup with a 404 on missing candidates, text ranking filtered by threshold and max_results, and default max_results overlay rendering. The feature metadata lists no tests, so regressions in branch selection, empty-match behavior, threshold filtering, or show_labels propagation would not be caught by the included evidence.
recommendation: Add focused API or handler-level tests that mock OCR results and overlay rendering for candidate_id, text, and default requests, including the missing-candidate 404 path.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature explicitly includes an empty tests list, and no test excerpts were provided as evidence of intended route behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Mock run_ocr and render_ocr_overlay_response, then assert POST /api/sdk/ocr/overlay filters by candidate_id, applies text threshold/max_results, returns 404 for an unknown candidate, and forwards show_labels to the renderer.
minimumFixScope: Focused tests for sdk_ocr_overlay branch behavior; no production code change is required unless tests expose a contract mismatch.
